status: fictional compact source-scene concept; not an Assetto Corsa ready pit; not FIA compliant or safety assessed
coordinates: metres; local X east, Y north, Z up; EPSG:32637 minus origin
direction: A-E-B-C-D-A; pit traversal follows main track southwest
source: OSM geometry from v04 surroundings_local.json; © OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL 1.0
placement: Sector D, left / southeast of travel, 74–145m before exact D, before the stream bridge; not moved to Tovarna Square
reason: The exact D junction is constrained by mapped buildings and intersecting Topoleva. A continuous conventional 150-300m pit through D would hit those constraints. This nearest compact candidate stays before the stream bridge.
capacity: 6 perpendicular small garage/parking bays; working space and car manoeuvring need validation; not 6 full F1 team boxes
vertical_design: Interpolate road elevation along reference_main_chainage and blend to existing road at both ends. Create a terrain cut under the new surface and a slope blend around its boundary; never place a coplanar overlay. Garage pads must be locally level. These heights use v04 provisional DSM-derived road profile.
assumptions_and_limits: OSM gaps are not proof of truly empty land. Fences, trees, driveways, gardens and unrecorded buildings need photos.
Widths, pavement and garages are fictional game-track design, not existing physical features.
Stream only has a mapped centerline: actual banks/floodplain are unverified. There is no new stream crossing in this concept.
This short pit needs very low speed and early deceleration on the main road; the sampled curve radius is geometry only, not a handling test.
Main road surface intersection is intentional only at entry and exit tapers. Apron and bays do not overlap the main road.
Do not remove mapped houses or streets to fit this concept. Reconsider after photo evidence and in-game driving tests.
